name: Bride of the Embalmer
summary: "Bride of the Embalmer" is a perilous task assigned by Lord Ello Ebonlocke in Darkshire. Having pieced together the disturbing truth behind the legendary Embalmer, town leadership sends you into the haunted cemeteries of Duskwood to find his resurrected wife's resting place. By tearing the alchemist's living heart from Eliza's cursed remains, you aim to strip him of his unholy power.

sections.title: A Bedtime Story Come Alive
sections.body: For years, parents in Duskwood told their frightened children the tale of the Embalmer. According to the folktale, he was once a kindly alchemist whose mind shattered following the tragic demise of his beloved wife, Eliza. Desperate to cheat mortality, he turned to foul sorceries and took the ultimate sacrifice: carving out his own beating heart and placing it into his wife's chest. Lord Ello Ebonlocke long dismissed this as mere village folklore, but recent revelations have proven that the Embalmer walks among them, his foul handiwork festering beneath the graveyard dirt.

sections.title: The Resurrected Bride
sections.body: The ritual succeeded in restoring Eliza to animation, but dark necromancy always demands a harrowing toll. Revived by the stolen spark of life, Eliza transformed into a ravenous abomination cursed with an insatiable hunger for living human flesh. Horrified and unwilling to destroy his creation, the Embalmer was forced to conceal his bride away in a lonely grave, visiting her in secret while plotting further depravities. To disarm the necromancer, Lord Ebonlocke directs brave souls to exhume Eliza, strike down the flesh-craving horror, and reclaim the still-pulsing organ that sustains his dark art.

sections.title: Darkshire's Aegis
sections.body: When you tear the beating heart from Eliza's decomposing breast and carry it back to Darkshire, Lord Ebonlocke breathes a sigh of relief. Far from simply destroying it, the town mayor intends to turn the alchemist's dark craft against him. He believes the eldritch magic lingering within the heart will serve as a defensive talisman and aegis over Darkshire, shielding the beleaguered town from whatever wrath the weakened Embalmer might still summon in vengeance.

faq.answer: The Embalmer was originally an alchemist in Duskwood who went mad after his wife Eliza died. Turning to necromantic arts, he cut out his own living heart and placed it inside Eliza's corpse to resurrect her, transforming himself into an elusive monster.

faq.q: Why was Eliza buried if she was brought back to life?
aliases: why keep eliza in a grave
faq.answer: Although the alchemist successfully revived Eliza using his own heart, the dark magic cursed her with an insatiable hunger for living human flesh. Unable to keep her safely in society or quench her feral appetite, he was forced to keep her buried in a cemetery.

faq.q: Why does Lord Ebonlocke want the Embalmer's Heart?
faq.answer: According to the tale Ello recounts, the heart is the source of the Embalmer's power. He asks you to retrieve it from Eliza's grave while it still beats, believing this will break that power.

faq.q: Where does this quest chain begin?
aliases: how to get bride of the embalmer
faq.answer: The quest follows directly from 'Translation to Ello', wherein old letters and research are delivered to Lord Ello Ebonlocke, proving that the Embalmer of local nursery tales is an active and dangerous reality.

faq.q: Does retrieving the heart defeat the Embalmer permanently?
faq.answer: Ello believes that retrieving the heart will break the Embalmer's power. The result of the mission is revealed when you return to Darkshire.

aliases: who starts bride of the embalmer
faq.answer: Lord Ello Ebonlocke, the mayor and leader of Darkshire, gives the quest from the Darkshire Town Hall after learning the chilling truth behind the town's folklore.

angles.text: Paladins view Eliza's foul reanimation as an affront to the Light and natural law, gladly purging the flesh-eating horror and severing the necromancer's blasphemous lifeline.
Priests recognize the tragedy behind a grieving widower fallen to dark arts, but know Eliza's flesh-hungry mockery of life must be laid to rest with holy finality.
With the Night Watch stretched thin fighting the feral terrors of Duskwood, an Alliance champion must step in to defend Darkshire from this ancient, creeping madness.
